stages.title: Brief
stages.instructions: Turn the request into a content brief with clara_criteria. Include audience, tone, length, and the call to action. Every criterion needs a human_gate or an artifact reference. Then call clara_stage_done with {"brief": "<brief>"}.

stages.title: Draft
stages.instructions: Write the draft from the approved brief. Call clara_stage_done with {"copy": "<draft>", "word_count": <n>}.

stages.title: Edit
stages.instructions: Edit the draft against the brief. Call clara_stage_done with {"final_copy": "<final copy>", "changes": "<summary>"}.

stages.title: Deliver
stages.instructions: Deliver the final copy. Call clara_stage_done with {"result": "<delivery summary>", "artifacts": [<paths or URLs>]} to complete the request.
